result.summary: Yes: the disposable proof Worker has code, assets, and D1, but not the deployed BettaView stack’s authenticated session, secrets, private service/Workflow bindings, provider transports, or Linear webhook registration. The separate safe adapter can operate on its test PR and Linear issue, but cannot connect to that Worker. No production credentials or deployment are requested; the missing piece is task-scoped nonproduction proof infrastructure. The implementation remains preserved with all 50 OpenSpec tasks complete. No application code changed; the saved 10 continuation/migration tests and 9 BettaView tests passed, and a fresh trusted `git diff --check` passed. All 12 real-application evidence scenarios remain honestly pending. Relevant contracts: [Cloudflare service bindings](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/runtime-apis/bindings/service-bindings/), [GitHub reviews](https://docs.github.com/en/rest/pulls/reviews), and [Linear webhooks](https://linear.app/developers/webhooks).
assumptions: The reply requests clarification; it does not authorize production access, credential sharing, or weaker evidence.
Production rollout remains deferred to the approved post-merge change.
Full tests were not rerun because no implementation code changed.
Pending scenarios cannot honestly be marked complete or not applicable with current capabilities.

question.question: Please choose the next path: should a workflow-runtime maintainer add a task-scoped nonproduction bridge connecting the real BettaView/ReviewContinuation Workers to the allocated safe GitHub and Linear resources—including signed webhook delivery, head advance, and an unlinked PR—or should the owner explicitly relax the requirement and accept tests/synthetic evidence?
question.reason: Nothing needs approval for production credentials. The temporary Worker and safe provider adapter are intentionally isolated, so the real application cannot exercise the required end-to-end behavior. A human reply cannot itself add that bridge, while stubs or direct provider writes would repeat the evidence already rejected in review.

linearQuestion.body:
Can the supervisor provide and rerun this attempt with an approved temporary proof capability that gives the real BettaView and ReviewContinuation Workers their required secrets, session/service/Workflow bindings, scoped GitHub/Linear transports, signed Linear webhook delivery to the temporary ingress, and safe fixture operations for head advance plus an unlinked pull request?

The current temporary publisher exposes only D1/R2/assets, while the safe adapter is a separate one-PR/one-issue interface. A human reply alone cannot add these capabilities, and a stub or direct adapter write would violate the review.

Reply here to continue implementation.
